{"schema": "CREATE TABLE customers (customer_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT, email TEXT,

response: {"thought": "語意層沒有命中「配送天數」，我先抽樣 shipments 與 orders 的時間欄位格式，確認時間字串格式與 UTC 儲存假設，再決定如何計算天數。", "tool": "sql_query", "args": {"query": "SELECT s.shipment_id, s.carrier, s.shipped_ts, s.delivered_ts, o.order_ts, typeof(s.delivered_ts) AS t FROM shipments s JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = s.order_id LIMIT 10"}}
